description: 40 steps counting the slot packets of clicks in the own window's 2x2 grid and a crafting table's grid: items put in, whole stacks and single items picked up by either button, halves, merges, shift-clicks, number keys both ways, throws of one and of all, a cursor swap, a remainder left by a honey bottle, and the window closed with the grid full; Circuit and both official servers send the same packets
